title: TerraGroup Labs weapon testing area key

infobox.usage: Unlocks the door to the laboratory weapon testing area (O11) in The Lab.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: TerraGroup Labs weapon testing area key (TGL WT) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the TerraGroup Labs Weapon testing area.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Can unlock two separate doors leading to the same room.
- Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the quest Following the Bread Crumbs

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: The Lab
sections.text:
- On the first level in room R15 (Gym) on a stool

- On the second level in room B21 (above the Server Room - B12) on the kitchen counter

- On the bottom of a shelf left of the entrance to room R23

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Laboratory weapon testing area (O11) on the first level in The Lab.

sections.heading: Behind The Lock
sections.text:
- One Weapon box (4x4)
- One Weapon box (6x6)
- Possible weapon spawns
- Loose loot (Weapon mods and ammunition)
